regions.today: A mix of cloud and bright spells with isolated showers. Highest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees with mostly light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy with outbreaks rain and drizzle. Showers will develop behind. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees, in moderate southwesterly winds, fresher along the coast.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of cloudy and clear skies with scattered showers. Sunny spells will develop at times through the day, the best of which will be to the southeast. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees in moderate to fresh westerly winds, stronger on the coast.
